Alcântara — Lisbon, Portugal

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Vale de Alcântara (Quinta do Loureiro, around Avenida de Ceuta) is a well-documented, recurring open-air drug trafficking and consumption site linked to the relocation of former Casal Ventoso residents. Diário de Notícias (13 Feb 2024) quoted a local parish leader saying "the drug problem has never been this bad" since 2017, describing hundreds of users, accumulated syringes and violence against both users and residents; the PSP ran repeated enforcement operations in 2025, including "Operação Portas Trancadas" (25 May 2025, 9 detained, traffickers barricading residential buildings) and a further pretrial-detention case (Observador, 25 May 2025). This is a serious, persistent problem rather than an isolated incident. Sources checked: Diário de Notícias, 13 Feb 2024 – "Droga: Tráfico e consumo a céu aberto aumentam no Vale de Alcântara"; RTP, 25 May 2025 – "Operação 'Portas Trancadas'. PSP de Lisboa prende nove pessoas por venda de droga"; Observador, 25 May 2025 – "Cinco pessoas em prisão preventiva por tráfico de droga no Vale de Alcântara"; Correio da Manhã – "Alerta para o consumo de droga no vale de Alcântara" (open letter from Alcântara and Campo de Ourique parish officials).
